allOf.description: Inherits shared step-base properties ($schema, id, owner, created_at, canonical_refs_used).

trace.description: Traceability links back to upstream artifacts (charter, system sketch).

items.description: A traceability reference for the delivery baseline.

environments.description: Map of deployment environments (dev, ci, staging, prod) with their configurations.

propertyNames.description: Environment name constraint: must be a valid environment (dev, ci, staging, prod).

additionalProperties.description: Environment configuration values for a specific deployment environment.

ci_gates.description: List of CI gate names that must pass before deployment (e.g., 'lint', 'unit-tests').

items.description: A CI gate identifier in kebab-case format.

secrets.description: List of secret names or keys required by the delivery pipeline.

compliance.description: List of compliance standards or frameworks the delivery must satisfy (e.g., 'SOC2', 'GDPR').

environment_ref.description: Canonical reference to the environment definitions in the canonical registry.

command_ref.description: Canonical reference to the command definitions used in CI gates.

policy_ref.description: Canonical reference to the compliance policies governing this delivery baseline.
